svg.title: Unlimited slot shapes
svg.desc: Data peak, START/STOP marker with its 180 degree phase reversal, and tune tone start, rendered by the Encoder (hf preset, 48 kHz).
svg.text: Slot shapes: real Encoder audio, hf preset (T 32 ms)
Rendered by the Encoder at 48 kHz; amplitude relative to the crest A; dashed: the envelope of spec 1.1.
grid tone, Tukey α 0.25: ramps T/8, no flip
Marker reversal, zoomed: the flat top of the STOP slot above, u = 0.25…0.75
purple: Encoder audio; gray dotted: the carrier before the reversal, continued; shaded: 0.375T–0.625T
Markers sit on f_ref and flip its sign for good (s ← −s); peaks sit on a grid tone and never flip.
Every envelope is 0 at the slot edges: no key clicks.
